text: A program an agent runs from inside a decade pane inherits DECADE_SOCKET, DECADE_PANE, DECADE_WORKSPACE and DECADE_MCP, so a decade-aware program such as coax connects to the live server as an agent in that pane. Test runs of such programs need env -u on all four and their own XDG_RUNTIME_DIR. Children::command in decade/src/server/children.rs sets the variables. Seen 2026-11-22 when a test coax joined the live server.
